concepts.name: SELECT basics
concepts.description: Select named columns from one table and distinguish rows from columns.

concepts.name: Filtering rows
concepts.description: Use WHERE and comparison predicates to filter rows.

concepts.name: Sorting results
concepts.description: Sort query results with ORDER BY and ascending or descending order.

concepts.name: Unique results
concepts.description: Use DISTINCT to remove duplicate result rows.

concepts.name: Limiting results
concepts.description: Limit the number of result rows and understand ordering before limiting.

concepts.name: Aggregate functions
concepts.description: Compute COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX over a set of rows.

concepts.name: Grouping rows
concepts.description: Group rows and compute an aggregate for each group.

concepts.name: Filtering groups
concepts.description: Filter grouped aggregate results with HAVING.

concepts.name: Inner joins
concepts.description: Combine rows from two tables using INNER JOIN and a join condition.

concepts.name: Left joins
concepts.description: Keep every left-table row when related right-table rows may be missing.

concepts.name: Join keys and cardinality
concepts.description: Choose join keys and diagnose duplicate rows from one-to-many relationships.

concepts.name: Self joins
concepts.description: Join a table to itself using aliases for hierarchical or comparative queries.

concepts.name: Combining result sets
concepts.description: Combine compatible query results with UNION or UNION ALL.

concepts.name: Subqueries
concepts.description: Use a nested SELECT as an input to an outer query.

concepts.name: Correlated subqueries
concepts.description: Understand a subquery that refers to columns from its outer query.

concepts.name: Existence checks
concepts.description: Use EXISTS and NOT EXISTS to check for related rows.

concepts.name: Common table expressions
concepts.description: Name an intermediate query using WITH to organize a query.

concepts.name: Conditional expressions
concepts.description: Build conditional result values with CASE WHEN.

concepts.name: Missing values
concepts.description: Use IS NULL and COALESCE and understand SQL three-valued logic.

concepts.name: SQL string functions
concepts.description: Transform and combine text with basic SQL string functions.

concepts.name: SQL date functions
concepts.description: Extract, compare and calculate with dates in SQL.

concepts.name: Type conversion
concepts.description: Convert SQL values between compatible types with CAST.

concepts.name: Window functions
concepts.description: Compute values over partitions while retaining individual result rows.

concepts.name: Window ranking
concepts.description: Rank rows with ROW_NUMBER, RANK and DENSE_RANK.

concepts.name: Window frames
concepts.description: Control a window frame to compute running or moving aggregates.

concepts.name: Inserting rows
concepts.description: Add rows with INSERT and specify the target columns.

concepts.name: Updating rows
concepts.description: Change rows using UPDATE and a deliberate WHERE condition.

concepts.name: Deleting rows
concepts.description: Delete selected rows using DELETE and understand the effect of WHERE.

concepts.name: Table constraints
concepts.description: Define primary keys, foreign keys and uniqueness constraints.

concepts.name: Debugging queries
concepts.description: Diagnose query errors and unexpected row counts using small examples.

concepts.name: Python basics
concepts.description: Run a small Python script and understand statements and indentation.

concepts.name: Variables
concepts.description: Assign and update variable values with meaningful names.

concepts.name: Basic types
concepts.description: Distinguish integer, float, boolean and string values and convert simple types.

concepts.name: Operators
concepts.description: Use arithmetic, comparison and boolean operators in expressions.

concepts.name: Strings
concepts.description: Create strings and format values using f-strings.

concepts.name: String methods
concepts.description: Use split, strip, replace and join on Python strings.

concepts.name: Lists
concepts.description: Create lists and add, remove or update list elements.

concepts.name: Tuples
concepts.description: Use immutable tuples and unpack their values.

concepts.name: Dictionaries
concepts.description: Store and retrieve key-value pairs in a dictionary.

concepts.name: Sets
concepts.description: Use sets to remove duplicates and compare collections.

concepts.name: Indexing and slicing
concepts.description: Select elements and slices from strings and sequences.

concepts.name: Conditional execution
concepts.description: Use if, elif and else to choose a branch.

concepts.name: For loops
concepts.description: Iterate over a sequence with for and range.

concepts.name: While loops
concepts.description: Repeat operations with while and terminate safely.

concepts.name: Defining functions
concepts.description: Define and call reusable Python functions.

concepts.name: Function parameters
concepts.description: Pass positional and keyword arguments and use default parameter values.

concepts.name: Return values
concepts.description: Return values from functions and distinguish return from print.

concepts.name: Variable scope
concepts.description: Distinguish local and module-level variable scope.

concepts.name: Comprehensions
concepts.description: Build lists and dictionaries with simple comprehensions.

concepts.name: Handling exceptions
concepts.description: Handle expected errors with try, except and finally.

concepts.name: Reading and writing files
concepts.description: Read and write text files using a context manager.

concepts.name: JSON data
concepts.description: Serialize and parse JSON data with Python's standard library.

concepts.name: Modules and imports
concepts.description: Import functions and organize code into modules.

concepts.name: Installing packages
concepts.description: Install a package and distinguish standard-library and third-party modules.

concepts.name: Virtual environments
concepts.description: Create and activate an isolated Python environment.

concepts.name: Debugging Python
concepts.description: Read tracebacks and isolate errors using small reproducible examples.

concepts.name: Basic tests
concepts.description: Write simple assertions and tests for a function.

concepts.name: Iteration helpers
concepts.description: Use enumerate and zip when iterating over collections.

concepts.name: Sorting collections
concepts.description: Sort a collection using sorted and a key function.

concepts.name: Dates and times
concepts.description: Parse and format basic date and time values with datetime.
